title: Extending Exact Integrality Gap Computations for the Metric TSP
summary: The subtour relaxation of the traveling salesman problem (TSP) plays a central role in approximation algorithms and polyhedral studies of the TSP. A long-standing conjecture asserts that the integrality gap of the subtour relaxation for the metric TSP is exactly $4/3$. In this paper, we extend the exact verification of this conjecture to a larger number of vertices. Using the framework introduced by Benoit and Boyd in 2008, we confirm their results up to $n=10$.
